text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! The sun is shining bright♪ Today, 
I'm just going to relax here—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Urrrgh... Can't really relax with my skin 
stinging like this, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to rough skin, Rhein Kraft doesn't 
seem able to enjoy sunbathing.
